projects.title: Lumen Atelier
projects.description: A fictional typography house and stationery brand built around a circulating-light motif. The identity uses a custom wordmark, a modular monogram, and a paper system for sample packs, letterheads, and invoices.

projects.title: Northward Transit
projects.description: A fictional city-transit poster series drawn in the style of mid-century travel illustration, inventing neighborhoods, line colors, and a night-service overlay. The set was imagined as a limited run of screen-printed sheets and a folding pocket map.

projects.title: Harborline Banking
projects.description: A fictional mobile banking app for a coastal credit union, with a calm dashboard, bill-pay flows, and a card-control screen. The interface is built around large type, low-clutter account summaries, and a tide-inspired accent system.

projects.title: Vera Canning Co.
projects.description: A fictional preserve and pickle line whose jars, sleeves, and shipping crates share a botanical stencil language. The system covers three seasonal SKUs, a gift crate, and a hanging shelf talker for market stalls.

projects.title: Paperorbit Quarterly
projects.description: A fictional independent design journal whose typographic grid, orbit diagrams, and essay layouts were drawn as a four-issue pilot year. Each issue pairs long-form criticism with a folded poster and a contents ribbon.

projects.title: Cedar Station
projects.description: A fictional commuter-rail interchange whose sign family, platform totems, and pedestrian maps use a cedar-and-steel vocabulary. The program includes entrance marks, track blades, and a simplified system map for hanging kiosks.
